description.it: I giocatori più preziosi e i migliori a fine contratto, in tutto il database o in una nazione o lega.
description.en: The most valuable players and the best ones near the end of their contract, everywhere or in one nation or league.

title.it: I 20 giocatori con il valore più alto

widgets.sql: SELECT name, transfer_value FROM players WHERE transfer_value IS NOT NULL AND age <= :max_age AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) ORDER BY transfer_value DESC LIMIT 20

title.it: In scadenza entro {months} mesi (per abilità attuale)

widgets.sql: SELECT p.name, p.age, p.club_name, p.natural_positions AS positions, p.ability_current, p.ability_potential, c."end" AS contract_end, c.wage, p.transfer_value FROM players p JOIN contracts c ON c.player_uid = p.uid WHERE c."end" <= date(:today, '+' || :months || ' months') AND p.age <= :max_age AND (:nation IS NULL OR p.club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR p.club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) ORDER BY p.ability_current DESC LIMIT :top

SELECT name, age, club_name, loan_parent_club_name AS owner_club, loan_end, ability_current, ability_potential FROM players WHERE on_loan = 1 AND age <= :max_age AND (:nation IS NULL OR club_nation_id = :nation) AND (:league IS NULL OR club_uid IN (SELECT r.club_uid FROM league_tables_rows r JOIN league_tables lt ON lt._import_id = r._import_id AND lt.league_tables_idx = r.league_tables_idx WHERE lt.competition_id = :league)) ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT :top
